Bob Dylan presents copy of his autobiography to Pope Leo XIV
Los Angeles, Nov 6 (IANS) Music legend, Bob Dylan recently met Pope Leo XIV, who had a private audience with the singer. The veteran singer is in Rome ahead of his Rough and Rowdy Ways concert at the Palazzo dello Sport on Thursday. He squeezed in some time, and paid a visit to the Pope's official residence, the Apostolic Palace, for a brief meeting.
The 85-year-old folk legend handed over a copy of his autobiography, ‘Chronicles: Volume One’ to the Pope. The pair posed for photographs, with the Pope’s all-white outfit contrasting starkly with Dylan's black ensemble.
He took to his X, formerly Twitter, and shared a picture of the two. He wrote, “Today, I had the privilege and the joy of accompanying #BobDylan to meet Pope Leo, together with Andrea Monda. It was hard not to feel the emotion of being part of an encounter that had a real sense of history about it, with the feeling that, at every step through the Apostolic Palace, absolutely anything could happen. Carlo Feltrinelli and Susan Pullman were also with us”.

passages.title: Bob Dylan meets Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican and swaps his memoir for a rosary
passages.passage:
Bob Dylan meets Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican and swaps his memoir for a rosary
Pope Leo meets Bob Dylan at the Vatican, November 4, 2026. Picture: Reuters
Bob Dylan met Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican on Wednesday, in a brief private audience during which the 85-year-old Nobel laureate and the first American-born pope exchanged gifts between the singer’s concert dates in Italy.
The Pope gave Dylan a rosary, and Dylan gave the pontiff a copy of his autobiography, Chronicles: Volume One. Vatican News described the meeting at the Apostolic Palace as “brief, consisting of greetings and a few lighthearted exchanges”.
The Vatican posted photographs of the meeting on Instagram. They show the two men shaking hands, talking at a table and posing in front of a piece of artwork. Leo wore his white cassock. Dylan wore a black hooded top under a coat, black gloves and a loosely knotted polka-dot tie, and in some pictures the hood was pulled over his head.

Teen Forced Into Car At Gunpoint, Raped By 2 Men In Bihar's Saharsa
A 14-year-old girl was raped by two men at gunpoint in Bihar's Saharsa, about 180 km from state capital Patna. The victim has told the police that the accused, identified as Bittu and Ankush, forced her to get into a car and then sexually assaulted her on Saturday.
According to the girl's family, she had taken goats for grazing on Saturday afternoon. When she was returning home, a car stopped next to her. Three men were inside, one of them the driver. Two of them called her. When she approached the vehicle, one of the men held a gun to her head and asked her to get in. After she did, the two men raped her. The car's audio was played at full blast to ensure that her screams were not heard. After sexually assaulting her for more than two hours, they left her on the roadside.
The girl did not tell her parents about the assault after she reached home. "Her parents started thrashing her when she did not tell them where she was. When I asked her, she told me what had happened. They had torn her clothes," the girl's aunt told the media. She said that the accused stared at the girl whenever she stepped out.
